last.verdict: Strong cloud growth, but heavy cash burn and debt kept investors cautious.

reasons.label: Cash still burning
reasons.text: Free cash flow was negative $5.4 billion despite record $23 billion operating cash flow.

reasons.label: Heavy debt load
reasons.text: Oracle carries about $125 billion of debt while spending $28.5 billion on data centers this quarter.

reasons.label: Dilution from stock sales
reasons.text: Oracle raised $20 billion selling new shares, adding to the share count investors own.

story: Oracle jumped about 9% in March on a huge backlog of cloud contracts. In June it fell about 8.5% as spending and financing plans grew. Now cloud growth is accelerating, but cash burn and debt keep capping the stock.
